claims.claim_text: AeroVironment closed the BlueHalo acquisition on May 1, 2025 pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger dated November 18, 2024 — converting BlueHalo equity into 17,425,849 shares of AVAV common stock (fair value $2,640,365,000) — adding operations in Florida, Pennsylvania, New Mexico, California, Maryland, Virginia, Alabama, and Ohio. Plus FY24 Tomahawk Robotics acquisition ($134.5M) and prior Arcturus, ISG, Telerob, Planck acquisitions form a rollup.

claims.object_value: BlueHalo (May 2025, ~$2.64B equity), Tomahawk (Sep 2023, $134.5M), Arcturus, ISG, Telerob, Planck
